create_strict_dataclass: create a strict dataclass with type validation on field assignment using the @strict decorator
create_validated_field: create a dataclass field with a custom validator function attached via validated_field
create_validated_field_decorator: create a dataclass field with a validator using the as_validated_field decorator
test_typed_dict: test that a dictionary conforms to types defined in a TypedDict schema using validate_typed_dict
review_strict_kwargs: review the @strict decorator with accept_kwargs=True to allow arbitrary keyword arguments in dataclass init
